description: This file handles booking verification via token, including GET and POST request handlers for confirming or rejecting bookings, with database interactions and external service calls.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests for booking verification, redirects on error.

methods.name: postHandler
methods.description: Handles POST requests for booking verification, processes reason for rejection if provided.

methods.name: handleBookingAction
methods.description: Performs booking confirmation or rejection, interacts with database and external confirmation handler, redirects based on success or failure.
